response: Please verify your login credentials and try resetting your password. If you still cannot access the account, contact account support.

instruction: Respond to the customer support request.

response: Open your account settings and update the registered email address. You may be asked to verify the new email before the change is completed.

instruction: Respond to the customer support request.
input: The application crashes when I open it.
response: Please restart the application and ensure that you are using the latest version. If the problem continues, reinstall the application or contact technical support.

instruction: Respond to the customer support request.
input: The application is running very slowly.
response: Try restarting the application and closing unnecessary background programs. If performance remains slow, check your network connection and update the application.

instruction: Respond to the customer support request.
input: I cannot connect to the service.
response: Please verify your internet connection and restart the application. If the service remains unavailable, check the service status or contact technical support.

instruction: Respond to the customer support request.

instruction: Respond to the customer support request.
input: I am not receiving the password reset email.
response: Check your spam or junk folder and confirm that you entered the email address registered with your account. You can request another reset email if required.

input: The latest update broke one of the features.
response: Please restart the application after the update and verify that you are running the latest release. If the feature remains unavailable, report the issue to technical support.
